FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS


## Questions before placing a bulk order?

Here are answers to some of the most common bulk gifting questions.


Can we see all products before ordering


Yes you can order sample or if you wish we can do a whatsapp video call and show you all options


What is the minimum quantity for bulk gifting?


Our bulk gifting enquiries start from 20 pieces.


What is the starting price?


Bulk gifting options start from ₹340 per gift. The final price depends on the product, quantity and customisation required.


Can the products be customised?


Yes. Customisation options are available for selected products depending on the quantity, design and order timeline.


How long does a bulk order take?


Timelines depend on the product, quantity and customisation. Our team will confirm the expected dispatch timeline before the order is finalised.


Do you deliver across India?


Yes. Grey Pottery handles bulk gifting dispatches across India.


Can you suggest products according to my budget?


Yes. Share your quantity, budget per gift and occasion, and our team will shortlist suitable options.


Do you provide corporate branding or logo customisation?


Branding and customisation possibilities depend on the product, quantity and available production timeline. Share your requirement and our team can confirm the available options.


Can I order for weddings, housewarmings or festive gifting?


Yes. We handle gifting requirements for weddings, corporate gifting, festivals, housewarmings, pooja functions, events and other celebrations.
